entries.source: Regesta Boica 11 (Regesta sive rerum Boicarum autographa ad annum usque MCCC. 11 = Continuatio 7), 7 Aug. 1396
entries.german: Stephan und Johannes Herzoge in Bayern verheissen Arnolden von Rosenberg an der über 800 fl. sich belaufenden und ihm auf dem Umgelt in Bayern angewiesenen Schuld auf Michaelis 200 fl. zu gewähren, bis zur völligen Bezahlung. G. Ingolstadt, Montag vor Laurenti. (Arrod. III. 641.)
entries.english: Stephan and Johannes, Dukes in Bavaria, promise Arnold von Rosenberg to pay 200 florins at Michaelmas on the debt, amounting to over 800 florins and assigned to him on the Umgeld in Bavaria, until full payment. Given at Ingolstadt, on the Monday before St. Lawrence. (Arrod. III. 641.)

facts.content: was promised by Dukes Stephan and Johannes of Bavaria payment of 200 florins at Michaelmas on a debt of over 800 florins assigned to him on the Umgeld in Bavaria, until full payment.
